previously--adv.def: At an earlier time than now.

wire--verb.def: To connect something with electrical wires.
wire--verb.ex: An electrician wired the new kitchen.
wire--verb.exTr: Bir elektrikçi yeni mutfağın kablolarını döşedi.

approach--verb.def: To come nearer, or to start dealing with something.

stock--noun.def: Goods kept for sale, or a share in a company.
stock--noun.ex: The shoes are out of stock.

tail--noun.def: The part that sticks out at the back of an animal.

rape--noun.def: The serious crime of forcing someone into sex.
rape--noun.ex: Rape carries a long prison sentence.
rape--noun.exTr: Tecavüz uzun bir hapis cezası gerektirir.

rape--verb.def: To commit the crime of forcing someone into sex.
rape--verb.ex: The court found that he had raped her.

nightmare--noun.def: A frightening dream, or a very bad experience.

lack--verb.def: To not have something you need.

actual--adj.def: Real, rather than what was expected or claimed.
actual--adj.ex: The actual cost was much higher.

flesh--noun.def: The soft part of a body between the skin and the bones.
flesh--noun.ex: The cut went deep into the flesh.

federal--adj.def: Relating to the central government of a country of states.

senator--noun.def: A member of a senate, a part of some parliaments.
senator--noun.ex: The senator voted against the bill.
senator--noun.exTr: Senatör yasa tasarısına karşı oy verdi.

reward--verb.def: To give someone something for good work or help.

alert--verb.def: To warn someone about a danger.
alert--verb.ex: A neighbour alerted the fire service.

panic--verb.def: To suddenly feel such fear that you cannot think.
panic--verb.ex: Do not panic if the lights go out.

pa--noun.def: An informal old word for father.
pa--noun.ex: His pa worked on the railway.

abandoned--adj.def: Left empty and no longer used or cared for.
abandoned--adj.ex: They sheltered in an abandoned barn.

guarantee--verb.def: To promise firmly that something will happen.
guarantee--verb.ex: We guarantee delivery within a week.
guarantee--verb.exTr: Bir hafta içinde teslimatı garanti ediyoruz.

bow--verb.def: To bend your head or body forward to show respect.
bow--verb.ex: The actors bowed to the audience.

revolution--noun.def: A complete change of government, or a great change in ideas.

coincidence--noun.def: Two things happening together by chance.

potential--adj.def: Possible in the future, though not yet real.

advance--noun.def: Forward movement or progress, or money paid early.

swing--noun.def: A seat hanging on ropes, or a swinging movement.
swing--noun.ex: The children queued for the swing.

swing--verb.def: To move back and forth from a fixed point.
swing--verb.ex: The gate swung in the wind.

whistle--verb.def: To make a high sound by blowing air through your lips.

assure--verb.def: To tell someone firmly that something is true.
assure--verb.ex: I assure you the room is clean.
assure--verb.exTr: Odanın temiz olduğuna sizi temin ederim.

billion--noun.ex: The project cost a billion lira.
billion--noun.exTr: Proje bir milyar liraya mal oldu.

mask--noun.def: A covering worn over the face.

species--noun.def: A group of animals or plants that can breed together.

loan--noun.def: Money lent that must be paid back.
loan--noun.ex: They took a loan for the shop.

struggle--verb.ex: He struggled to lift the crate.

navy--noun.def: The part of a country's forces that fights at sea.

guts--noun.def: Courage and determination, in informal speech.
guts--noun.ex: It took guts to say that.

coward--noun.def: A person who is too afraid to face danger.
coward--noun.ex: Nobody wants to be called a coward.

flash--noun.def: A sudden bright light that lasts a moment.
flash--noun.ex: A flash of lightning lit the road.

flash--verb.ex: The lighthouse flashes every ten seconds.
flash--verb.exTr: Deniz feneri her on saniyede bir yanıp sönüyor.

impressed--adj.ex: We were impressed by her calm.

supply--verb.def: To provide people with what they need.
supply--verb.ex: The farm supplies milk to the town.

sensitive--adj.def: Easily affected or hurt, or needing careful treatment.

confess--verb.def: To admit that you did something wrong.
confess--verb.ex: He confessed to taking the money.

suspicious--adj.def: Making you think something is wrong, or not trusting.
suspicious--adj.ex: The neighbours heard a suspicious noise.

joint--noun.def: A place where two bones or two parts meet.

assault--noun.def: A violent physical attack on someone.

trail--verb.def: To follow behind, or to be losing in a contest.
trail--verb.ex: Our team trailed by two goals.

mighty--adj.ex: A mighty river crosses the plain.

balance--verb.def: To keep something steady, or to make two sides equal.
balance--verb.ex: She balanced the tray on one hand.

reaction--noun.def: What you feel or do because of something that happened.

version--noun.def: One form of something that exists in several forms.

gear--noun.def: A part that controls speed in a vehicle, or equipment.

defeat--noun.def: The state of losing a game or a war.

blast--noun.def: An explosion, or a strong rush of air.
blast--noun.ex: The blast was heard across the city.

blast--verb.def: To break something apart with explosives.
blast--verb.ex: Workers blasted a tunnel through the rock.

bud--noun.def: A small growth on a plant that opens into a flower.

rip--verb.def: To tear something quickly and roughly.

tunnel--noun.def: A passage dug under the ground or through a hill.
tunnel--noun.ex: The tunnel is two kilometres long.

surrender--verb.def: To stop fighting and accept that you have lost.
surrender--verb.ex: The town surrendered after a week.
surrender--verb.exTr: Kasaba bir hafta sonra teslim oldu.

pee--verb.def: An informal word meaning to pass water from the body.

stress--verb.def: To say strongly that something matters.
stress--verb.ex: He stressed that time was short.

noble--adj.def: Morally good and generous, or of high birth.

legend--noun.def: An old story about the past, or a very famous person.
legend--noun.ex: A local legend explains the name.

mix--noun.ex: Use a mix of flour and salt.

fox--noun.def: A wild animal with red fur and a bushy tail.
fox--noun.ex: A fox crossed the field at dusk.

gross--adj.def: Total before anything is taken off, or very unpleasant.

classic--noun.def: A book, a film or a car of lasting quality.

therapy--noun.def: Treatment for an illness, especially without drugs.

lifetime--noun.def: The period during which someone is alive.
lifetime--noun.ex: He saw great change in his lifetime.

experiment--verb.def: To try a new method to see what happens.

cheat--verb.def: To act dishonestly in a test or a game.
cheat--verb.ex: He was caught cheating in the exam.

servant--noun.def: A person employed to work in someone's house.
servant--noun.ex: The house once had four servants.
servant--noun.exTr: Evde bir zamanlar dört hizmetli vardı.

practically--adv.def: Almost, or in a way that is useful in real life.

wipe--verb.def: To clean a surface by rubbing it.
wipe--verb.ex: Wipe the table with a damp cloth.

deck--noun.def: A floor of a ship, or a flat wooden area outside a house.
deck--noun.ex: We sat on the upper deck.

influence--verb.def: To have an effect on how someone thinks or acts.

torture--verb.def: To cause someone severe pain on purpose.
torture--verb.ex: The report says prisoners were tortured.

division--noun.def: The act of separating into parts, or a section of a company.

scratch--verb.def: To rub your skin with your nails, or to mark a surface.

motion--noun.def: Movement, or a formal proposal at a meeting.
motion--noun.ex: The motion of the boat made him ill.
